proposed_comments.title: Retry failed registry cleanup

confidence.rationale: The newly added completion-marker call is unconditional, while the exact upstream helper returns void and discards every registry deletion status; the preceding marker guard then suppresses later attempts.

proposed_comments.body:
### Retry failed registry cleanup

**Severity:** `medium`

The completion marker is written immediately after `clean_video_conference()`, but that helper currently returns `void` and ignores every `RegDeleteTreeW` status. If one deletion fails, this records the cleanup as complete and all later elevated starts skip retrying, leaving a legacy device registration behind. Please make the helper report aggregate cleanup success (treat `ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND` as already clean) and write this marker only when the cleanup succeeds; otherwise leave it unset so startup retries.
